title: Guitar Path
subtitle: Ten levels from first chords to playing pretty well: strumming, fingerpicking, lead and riffs, with songs at every level.

levels.title: First chords: A, D, E and the three minors
levels.goal: Strum a three-chord song with steady downstrokes and play a one-string riff from tab.
levels.adds: Tuning, A D E Am Em Dm, One Minute Changes, quarter-note downstrokes, thumb on the bass, tab, notes on strings 6 and 5.

steps.title: Tune by ear and by tuner
steps.setup: The tuner, all six strings.
steps.done: All six strings within 10 cents, unaided, in under 2 minutes, on two days.

steps.title: Build A, D and E
steps.setup: Chords, Build: A, then D and E.
steps.done: Each shape rings clean 5 times running, on two days.

steps.title: Downstrokes on 1 2 3 4
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: four on the floor, 60 then 72.
steps.done: 90% on time at 72 BPM, 3 runs, on two days.

steps.title: One Minute Changes: A-D, D-E, A-E
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: timed, 60 seconds, one pair at a time.
steps.done: 30 changes a minute on each pair, on two days. First tries of 6 to 9 are normal.

steps.title: Build Am, Em and Dm
steps.setup: Chords, Build: Am, then Em and Dm.
steps.done: Each shape rings clean 5 times running, on two days.

steps.title: Changes Am-E, Em-D, Dm-A and A-Am
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: timed, 60 seconds, one pair at a time.
steps.done: 30 changes a minute on each pair, on two days.

steps.title: Strum a three-chord song form
steps.setup: Strum a song: Three Little Birds or Wild Thing, downstrokes, 70% of the record's tempo.
steps.done: Two clean passes of the song form at 70%, then at 100%.
steps.needs: Song presets in Strum a progression (phase 2, stage 4).

steps.title: Thumb on the bass
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: boom-chick with the thumb on the root, A D E, 60.
steps.done: Root on the right string every beat, 3 clean runs at 70, on two days.

steps.title: Free strokes with i and m
steps.setup: Phrases: Twinkle, alternating i and m on strings 1 and 2.
steps.done: Clean at 80, alternating fingers, on two days.

steps.title: Read tab, play a one-string riff
steps.setup: Song Studio, Performance: the Seven Nation Army riff from the shelf, then Peter Gunn.
steps.done: The riff at 100 BPM 3 times clean, then at the record's tempo.

steps.title: Name the notes on strings 6 and 5
steps.setup: Fretboard, Note finder: strings 6 and 5, frets 0 to 5, naturals.
steps.done: 20 answers, 90% right, under 3 seconds each.

steps.title: Hear the change
steps.setup: Chords, Strum and identify: A, D and E.
steps.done: 80% over 20.

shelf.title: Three Little Birds
shelf.teaches: A D E with a reggae feel
shelf.detail: A, 74 BPM, A D E; downstrokes, later off-beat chops

shelf.title: Wild Thing
shelf.teaches: A D E stabs, rock eighths
shelf.detail: A, 105 BPM, A D E (G in the fill)

shelf.title: A Horse With No Name
shelf.teaches: A two-chord minor song, a preview of Old Faithful
shelf.detail: E dorian, 122 BPM, Em and D6/9

shelf.title: Free Fallin'
shelf.teaches: D Dsus4 A with a capo; also picked with thumb and fingers

shelf.title: Seven Nation Army
shelf.teaches: A one-string riff, tab reading

shelf.title: Smoke on the Water
shelf.teaches: A riff on one string, then as fourths

shelf.title: Peter Gunn Theme
shelf.teaches: A low-string riff, steady eighths

shelf.title: Ode to Joy
shelf.teaches: i-m free strokes, first notes on the staff
shelf.detail: C or G, 80 BPM, strings 1 to 3

fallback.label: In the app: Phrases, Ode to Joy

levels.test: One strummed song and one riff song from the shelf at the record's tempo, with the record, without stopping; three random pairs from A D E Am Em Dm at 30 changes a minute; Ode to Joy or step 1.8 clean at 70.

levels.title: C and G, Old Faithful, first arpeggios
levels.goal: Play the G C D Em family of songs with a real strum pattern, and pick an arpeggio through a progression.
levels.adds: C and G, Old Faithful (D DU UDU), the common pairs, p-i-m-a and folk arpeggios, two-string riffs, first-position notes on strings 1 to 3 from the staff.

steps.title: Build C and G
steps.setup: Chords, Build: C, then G. The app's G is the three-finger shape; learn the four-finger G (320033) beside it.
steps.done: Each shape rings clean 5 times running, on two days.

steps.title: Changes C-G, G-D, C-Am, G-Em and C-D
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: timed, 60 seconds, one pair at a time.
steps.done: 30 changes a minute on each pair, on two days.

steps.title: Hardest five
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: the five slowest pairs from your history.
steps.done: The 5 slowest pairs at 30 changes a minute each.
steps.needs: A hardest-five setting in Changes, picked from per-pair history.

steps.title: Old Faithful
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: Old Faithful (D DU UDU), 70 then 85.
steps.done: 90% on time at 85, on two days.

steps.title: Echo a strum rhythm
steps.setup: Rhythm, Echo: the dotted level.
steps.done: 5 unaided echoes, 75% on average.

steps.title: Strum G-D-Em-C
steps.setup: Strum a progression: G-D-Em-C with Old Faithful at 80. Strum a progression is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Chord following at 90%, 4 passes, on two days.
steps.feeds: Stand by Me, Knockin' on Heaven's Door

steps.title: p-i-m-a arpeggio
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: p-i-m-a in eighths over C Am G Em, 60 then 80.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 80, on two days.

steps.title: Folk arpeggio p-i-m-i
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: folk p-i-m-i over G Em C D, 70 then 80.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 80, on two days.
steps.feeds: Knockin' on Heaven's Door (picked), Leaving on a Jet Plane

steps.title: Two-string riffs
steps.setup: Song Studio, Performance: the Come As You Are riff, then Satisfaction (linked).
steps.done: Each at the record's tempo, 3 clean runs.

steps.title: First position from the staff
steps.setup: Note reading, Flashcards: play each written note on the guitar, naturals. The range follows the reading level until a strings 1 to 3 setting exists.
steps.done: 20 answers, 90% right, under 3 seconds each.

steps.title: Read a melody
steps.setup: Phrases: Amazing Grace from the notation, i-m strokes.
steps.done: Clean at 80, on two days.

steps.title: Hear I, IV and V
steps.setup: Ear, Chords in a key: I, IV and V (Ear path step 5).
steps.done: 80% over 20.

shelf.title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
shelf.teaches: G D Am and G D C with Old Faithful; picked with the folk arpeggio

shelf.title: Stand by Me
shelf.teaches: G Em C D loop, swing feel

shelf.title: Bad Moon Rising
shelf.teaches: D A G, fast changes, eighths

shelf.title: Leaving on a Jet Plane
shelf.teaches: G C D with Old Faithful, then the folk arpeggio

shelf.teaches: Am Em G in a minor soul groove, accents

levels.test: One S song and one F or R song at the record's tempo; the hardest five at 30 changes a minute; p-i-m-a through G Em C D clean at 80.

levels.title: Sevenths, sus chords, the island strum and first Travis
levels.goal: Colour chords, a syncopated strum and a thumb that alternates on its own.
levels.adds: A7 D7 E7 G7 C7 B7, Fmaj7 and the mini F, sus2, sus4 and add9 with anchor fingers, the island strum, 16th strumming, an alternating-bass thumb, one-finger Travis, the open E minor pentatonic, hammer-ons and pull-offs, eighth-note rhythm reading.

steps.title: Build the open sevenths
steps.setup: Chords, Build: A7, D7, E7 and C7 (the app's generated open shapes), then G7 and B7.
steps.done: Each shape rings clean 5 times running, on two days.
steps.feeds: Twist and Shout, the Level 4 blues

steps.title: Fmaj7, then the mini F
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: C-Fmaj7, then Am-F, timed. The app's F is the full barre: fret Fmaj7 (xx3210) and the mini F (xx3211), the clock hears the chord.
steps.done: 30 changes a minute on each pair, on two days.

steps.title: Sus, add9 and anchor fingers
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: the cycle Em7, G, Dsus4, A7sus4, Cadd9, timed. Keep fingers 3 and 4 anchored on strings 1 and 2; the clock hears the chord, not the shape.
steps.done: 30 changes a minute on the cycle, on two days.

steps.title: Island strum with a mute
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: the island strum at 84.
steps.done: 90% at 84, on two days.

steps.title: Sixteenth strumming
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: straight sixteenths, 60 then 87. The Wonderwall strum pattern is still to come; this builds the sixteenth motion.

steps.title: Thumb alternates
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: Travis bass over C, G and Am, 60 then 80.
steps.done: Thumb steady, 3 clean runs at 80, on two days.

steps.title: One finger on top
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: Travis with the middle finger over C Am G, 70.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 80.

steps.title: Rolling 3/4 arpeggio
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: the Scarborough Fair preset (Am G Am C Am D in 3/4), 60% of its tempo, then 100%.
steps.done: Clean at 100%, on two days.

steps.title: Open E minor pentatonic
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: minor pentatonic box 1 at the nut, eighths at 80.
steps.done: Up and down 3 times clean at 80.

steps.title: Hammer-ons and pull-offs
steps.setup: Fretboard, Hammer-ons and pull-offs: 0 2 0 at 80. The drill starts at fret 1; play the open-string version on your own first.
steps.done: The legato check passes 3 runs.
steps.feeds: Sunshine of Your Love, the Good Riddance intro

steps.title: Riffs with a moving bass
steps.setup: Song Studio, Performance: the My Girl riff; Oh Pretty Woman, Sunshine of Your Love and the Brown Eyed Girl intro are linked.
steps.done: One riff at the record's tempo, 3 clean runs.

steps.title: Read eighths and rests
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: eighths and rests at 80.
steps.done: 90% on two days.

steps.title: Hear major, minor and dominant 7
steps.setup: Ear, Chord qualities: major, minor and dominant 7.
steps.done: 80% over 30.

levels.title: Power chords, the 12-bar, the F chord and Travis proper
levels.goal: Play rock riffs with palm muting, a 12-bar shuffle, and a full Travis pattern under a song.
levels.adds: E5 A5 G5 D5 moving along strings 6 and 5, palm-muted eighths, the boogie shuffle in A and E, dominant-7 blues strumming, the full F, Travis (alternating bass plus two fingers), the 6/8 arpeggio, minor pentatonic box 1 at fret 5, a first lick, all six strings in first position.

steps.feeds: Iron Man, Smells Like Teen Spirit

steps.title: Palm-muted eighths

steps.title: Boogie shuffle in A and E
steps.setup: Phrases: Boogie shuffle, swing feel, 80 then 110.
steps.done: 12 bars clean at 110, on two days.

steps.title: The full F

levels.title: The barre begins, 6/8, pinches and bends
levels.goal: A first real barre chord in songs, a 6/8 ballad strummed and picked, a pinch pattern under a melody, and bends that land in tune.
levels.adds: The E-shape F barre, A-shape Bm and Bb, 6/8 strumming, accents and ghost strums, Travis with a pinch, the alternating-bass p-i-m-a, a melody over a thumb bass, half and whole bends to pitch, vibrato, four stock box-1 licks, finding a melody by ear, dotted rhythms.

steps.title: A-shape Bm and Bb

levels.title: Moving barres, the major scale, blues lead and the first Travis classics

levels.adds: E and A shape majors, minors and sevenths anywhere, the major scale (6th-string root), the B.B. box, slides, call and response, syncopated Travis with pinches and hammer-ons, a fingerpicked riff in time (Fast Car), reading on all six strings.

levels.title: CAGED, triads, funk and the big fingerstyle pieces
levels.goal: See chords and scales as one map across the neck, play a funk part, and play Tears in Heaven or Blackbird through.
levels.adds: The five CAGED shapes, triads on strings 1-3 and 2-4, minor pentatonic box 2 and the 1-2 connection, 16th funk strumming with mutes, Hendrix-style chord embellishments, Blackbird's thumb-and-finger pinch, licks in D minor, improvising two choruses.

steps.title: CAGED shapes as arpeggios
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: the CAGED major shapes C, A, G, E and D, in one key.
steps.done: Each shape at 80, on two days.

steps.title: Triads on strings 1-3 and 2-4
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: three inversions on two string sets.
steps.done: All six for G, C and D at 60.
steps.needs: Triad positions in Fretboard: three inversions on strings 1-3 and 2-4.

steps.title: Box 2 and the 1-2 link
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: minor pentatonic box 2, then boxes 1 and 2 in turn. A connected run across the boxes is still to come.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 90.

steps.title: Funk 16ths with mutes
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: straight sixteenths, 80 then 100. The muted-scratch funk pattern is still to come.

steps.title: Chord embellishments
steps.setup: Phrases: Hey Joe fills, Little Wing-style hammer-on decorations.
steps.done: 2 phrases at 80.
steps.needs: Chord embellishment phrases in Phrases (Hey Joe fills, Little Wing-style hammer-ons).

steps.title: Tears in Heaven pattern
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: the Tears in Heaven preset.
steps.done: Clean at 100%, on two days.

steps.title: Tears in Heaven in full
steps.setup: Song Studio: wait mode, then Performance.
steps.done: The whole piece at 100%, 90% of notes, on two days.

steps.title: Blackbird thumb-and-finger
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: the Blackbird pinch, p with i or m together, tenths, the open G string as a drone.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 70.
steps.needs: A Blackbird pinch pattern in Fingerpicking.

steps.title: Blackbird in full
steps.setup: Song Studio: section A, then B, fix-the-spot on the 3/4 and 2/4 bars.
steps.done: The whole piece at 90 BPM (the record is 94), on two days.

steps.title: D minor licks
steps.setup: Licks: 6 Santana-style licks in D minor pentatonic and Dorian.
steps.done: Each at 90 in Check mode.
steps.needs: Six Santana-style guitar licks in D minor pentatonic and Dorian in Licks.

steps.title: Improvise two choruses
steps.setup: Jam: 12-bar in E and in A, and a minor vamp, with boxes 1 and 2. Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Two choruses, no stops, in time.

steps.title: Reading in second and fifth position
steps.setup: Note reading, Sight-reading: guitar, 8 bars at 60, read in fifth position. A position setting (Leavitt order) is still to come.
steps.done: 8 bars at 60 in fifth position, 90% of notes.

steps.title: Hear chord qualities in progressions
steps.setup: Ear, Progressions in major and minor keys (Ear R3). Borrowed chords (I-bVII-IV, i-bVII-bVI-V) are still to come.

shelf.teaches: fingerstyle with the melody on top, bass walks

levels.title: All five boxes, real improvising and the intros everyone knows
levels.goal: Move freely across the neck in one key, improvise over pop and blues backings, and play the famous intros (Stairway, Nothing Else Matters, Sweet Child) at tempo.
levels.adds: Minor pentatonic boxes 3 to 5 and the full map, the major pentatonic, natural minor, target notes on chord changes, the Texas shuffle, 9th and 13th soul voicings, speed bursts, learning a solo from the score and by ear.

steps.title: Boxes 3, 4 and 5
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: minor pentatonic boxes 3, 4 and 5 in A, 90.
steps.done: Each at 90, on two days.

steps.title: The whole neck in one key
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: the connected boxes in A minor, frets 5 to 17, 80.
steps.done: Up and down the neck clean at 80.
steps.feeds: Comfortably Numb, Sweet Child O' Mine

steps.title: Major pentatonic
steps.setup: Fretboard, Positions: box 1 at the nut, read from G as the G major pentatonic (a major pentatonic label is still to come); then Jam: I-V-vi-IV in G. Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Two choruses over I-V-vi-IV, landing on chord tones on the 1.
steps.feeds: Johnny B. Goode, country and pop solos

steps.title: Natural minor
steps.setup: Scales: A natural minor on the guitar, eighths at 80. A 6th-string-root pattern in Positions is still to come.
steps.done: At 80, on two days.
steps.feeds: Stairway, the Nothing Else Matters solo

steps.title: Target notes on the change
steps.setup: Jam: 12-bar in A with the chord tones lit; land on the 3rd of each new chord. Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: 3 choruses, 80% of changes hit.

steps.title: Texas shuffle
steps.setup: Phrases: the Texas shuffle rhythm (SRV), 120.
steps.done: 12 bars clean at 120.
steps.needs: A Texas shuffle rhythm (SRV) in Phrases.

steps.title: Soul voicings
steps.setup: Chords, Build: E9 (open), C9 (x32333) and Em9 (open), the app's generated shapes. 13th chords are still to come.
steps.done: Each rings clean 5 times running, on two days.

steps.title: Speed bursts
steps.setup: Fretboard, speed bursts: 4 to 6 notes looped, a tempo ladder on evenness.
steps.done: The Sweet Child intro cell at 120 in 16ths, even.

steps.title: Nothing Else Matters intro
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: the Nothing Else Matters preset (Em D C), then Song Studio for the full intro.
steps.done: The intro at the record's tempo, on two days.

steps.title: Stairway intro
steps.setup: Song Studio: the first 16 bars, the descending bass with p, the melody with i, m and a.
steps.done: At 72, 90% of notes.

steps.title: Learn a solo from the score
steps.setup: Song Studio: Comfortably Numb solo 1 in 2-bar sections, fix-the-spot. The Johnny B. Goode intro is linked but not judged here.
steps.done: The whole solo at 100%, on two days.

steps.title: Learn a lick by ear
steps.setup: Learn it by ear: 4 bars of a shelf solo, slowed down.
steps.done: Played matching the record at 75%.
steps.needs: The learn-it-by-ear player (Ear R2: loop, slow down, pitch kept).

levels.title: Broaden: fingerstyle arrangements, jazz shells and modes
levels.goal: Play a melody-on-top fingerstyle arrangement of a pop song, comp a jazz standard with shell voicings, and solo with a mode.
levels.adds: Melody and bass arrangements (Here Comes the Sun, Yesterday), a percussive fingerstyle arrangement (More Than Words), shell voicings with roots on strings 6 and 5, ii-V-I, Dorian and Mixolydian, Hendrix chord embellishment in full, sight-reading in fifth position.

steps.title: Melody on top, bass below
steps.setup: Song Studio: the Here Comes the Sun arrangement, verse then chorus, the thumb independent.
steps.done: Verse and chorus at 100%, on two days.

steps.title: A percussive fingerstyle arrangement
steps.setup: Song Studio: the More Than Words intro, thumb slaps and hammer-on chords.
steps.done: The intro at 70, 90% of notes, on two days.

steps.title: Greensleeves with variations
steps.setup: Song Studio: the Greensleeves arrangement with tab, read from the notation.
steps.done: The theme and one variation at 90 in 3/4.

steps.title: Shell voicings
steps.setup: Voicings, guitar shells: 1-3-7 and 1-7-3 with roots on strings 6 and 5.
steps.done: maj7, m7 and 7 in 12 keys at 60 changes a minute.
steps.needs: Guitar shell voicings (1-3-7 and 1-7-3, roots on strings 6 and 5).

steps.title: ii-V-I
steps.setup: Jam: ii-V-I and minor ii-V-i, comping; then Chord scales. Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Comp 4 choruses with no missed change.

steps.title: Dorian
steps.setup: Jam: the D Dorian vamp, with Scales for D Dorian. A Dorian position pattern is still to come. Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Two choruses, landing on the 6th as colour.

steps.title: Mixolydian and the blues mix
steps.setup: Jam: 12-bar in A, mixing minor and major pentatonic; Scales for A Mixolydian. A Mixolydian position pattern is still to come. Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Two choruses, 3rds on the I chord.
steps.feeds: Sultans of Swing, Johnny B. Goode

levels.title: Capstone: RGT Grade 5 and JustinGuitar Grade 6 standard
levels.goal: A performance set and an exam-style check.
levels.adds: No new topic: higher tempos, stamina (whole pieces from memory) and unseen material.

steps.title: Scales at grade tempo
steps.setup: Scales: major, natural minor, Dorian and Mixolydian in eighths at 80 (the Rockschool Grade 5 click); the five pentatonic boxes in sixteenths at 70 in Positions, linked.
steps.done: Each clean at 80 in eighths; the pentatonic boxes in 16ths at 70.

steps.title: Chords at grade tempo
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: the hardest five across all shapes (open, barre, 7ths, 9ths, shells).
steps.done: 60 changes a minute on each.
steps.needs: The hardest-five setting in Changes, across every shape.

steps.title: Unseen backing improvisation
steps.setup: Jam: a progression and key you did not choose (a surprise-me setting is still to come). Jam is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: Two choruses in time, chord tones on the downbeats 70% of the time.

steps.title: Unseen rhythm part
steps.setup: Strum a progression: an unseen 8-bar chart with a written rhythm.
steps.done: 90% on the first try.
steps.needs: Generated 8-bar charts with a written rhythm in Strum a progression (from the Ear R8 rhythm levels).

steps.title: A full fingerstyle piece from memory
steps.setup: Song Studio, performance mode with the score hidden (a hide-score setting is still to come). Song Studio is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: The whole piece, 90% of notes, on two days.

steps.title: A full learned solo
steps.setup: Song Studio: a solo from the shelf. Song Studio is practice only, so this step opens it and is not judged.
steps.done: At 100% tempo, on two days.

steps.title: Sight-reading
steps.setup: Note reading, Sight-reading: guitar, first and fifth position, at 72. The drill tops out at 8 bars, so read two in a row.
steps.done: 16 bars at 72, 90% on the first try.

steps.title: Ear tests
steps.setup: Ear: melody dictation of 2 bars, then chord qualities and I-IV-V-vi progressions (linked).
steps.done: 80% on each.

steps.title: Record the set
steps.setup: Record: three songs, one per strand (S or R, F, L).
steps.done: Listen back, mark three spots, fix them, record again.

levels.test: A 15-minute set from memory: one S or R song, one fingerstyle piece (Classical Gas, Blackbird or Dust in the Wind) and one solo (learned, or improvised over an unseen backing); plus scales at 80, 8 bars sight-read at 72 and two ear items. Pass on two different days.
